rules.citation: ASCI Influencer Advertising Guidelines 2026, disclosure sufficiency and placement
rules.check: post.disclosure_tag in ['#Ad','#Advertisement','#Sponsored','#Promotion','#Paid','#PaidPartnership'] AND post.disclosure_position == 'first_line' AND post.disclosure_in_trailing_hashtag_cluster == false, OR post.platform_native_label == 'paid_partnership_with
rules.failure_message: Paid partnership disclosure missing, ambiguous, or not in the first line.

rules.citation: ASCI Influencer Advertising Guidelines 2026, video and ephemeral disclosure duration
rules.check: if artifact.format_is_ephemeral: artifact.disclosure_visible_throughout == true; elif artifact.duration_sec <= 15: artifact.disclosure_visible_duration_sec >= 3; elif artifact.duration_sec <= 120: artifact.disclosure_visible_duration_sec >= artifact.duration_sec / 3; else: artifact.disclosure_visible_throughout == true

rules.citation: ASCI Influencer Advertising Guidelines 2026, verbal disclosure requirement
rules.applies_when: artifact.paid_partnership == true AND (artifact.is_video == true OR artifact.is_audio == true)
rules.check: if artifact.is_video: artifact.verbal_disclosure_present == true AND artifact.verbal_disclosure_start_sec <= 10; if artifact.is_audio: artifact.verbal_disclosure_at_segment_start == true
rules.failure_message: Verbal disclosure required within the first 10 seconds of video, or at the start of an audio brand segment. A text overlay alone is not sufficient.

rules.citation: ASCI Draft Guidelines for Responsible Labelling of AI-Generated Content in Advertising, 8 May 2026, read with IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules 2026
rules.check: artifact.ai_risk_tier != 'high' AND artifact.ai_label_present == true AND artifact.ai_label_accurately_describes_use == true AND artifact.ai_label_meets_disclaimer_prominence == true AND (artifact.is_video == false OR (artifact.ai_label_within_first_5_sec == true AND artifact.ai_label_at_end == true))
rules.failure_message: High-risk AI use is prohibited and labelling does not cure it. Medium-risk use requires a prominent, accurate label.

rules.citation: ASCI restrictions on AI personas addressing children, April 2026
rules.check: artifact.product_category not in ['junk_food','high_sugar_beverage','weight_loss']

rules.citation: ASCI Influencer Guidelines Addendum 2, 7 April 2025, BFSI qualification disclosure
rules.check: credential_registry.lookup(artifact.influencer_qualification_credential_id).valid == true AND the qualification appears in the artifact copy

rules.citation: ASCI Influencer Guidelines Addendum 2, 7 April 2025, health and nutrition qualification disclosure
rules.check: credential_registry.lookup(artifact.influencer_qualification_credential_id).valid == true

rules.citation: CCPA Guidelines on Dark Patterns, November 2023, read with ASCI 2026 enforcement focus
rules.applies_when: artifact.offer_mechanics or artifact.ui_elements intersects [countdown_timer, stock_indicator, scarcity_badge, subscription_flow, checkout_path, free_trial_auto_renew, drip_pricing, consent_gate, unsubscribe_flow, pre_ticked_option, urgency_banner] OR artifact.has_commercial_flow == true OR artifact.dark_patterns_present is non-empty
rules.check: artifact carries no pattern from the CCPA dark-pattern list and disclosure_legible == true

rules.citation: ASCI Guidelines for Advertising of Environmental and Sustainability Claims
rules.check: artifact.claim_substantiated_with_third_party_certification == true OR artifact.claim_quantified_with_specific_metric == true OR artifact.claim_qualified_with_scope_disclosure == true

rules.citation: DPDP Act 2023 read with DPDP Rules 2025, notified 13 November 2025
rules.applies_when: artifact.uses_custom_audience == true OR artifact.uses_crm_upload == true OR artifact.uses_whatsapp_marketing == true
rules.check: artifact.consent_artifact_id present AND consent_vault.lookup(artifact.consent_artifact_id).status == 'valid' AND consent_vault.lookup(artifact.consent_artifact_id).purpose matches artifact.processing_purpose

rules.citation: DPDP Act 2023 section 9, processing of personal data of children
rules.check: artifact.targeting_bases and artifact.audience_signals contain no behavioural signal AND consent_vault.lookup(artifact.parental_consent_artifact_id).consent_type == 'verifiable_parental' AND status == 'valid

rules.citation: DPDP Rules 2025, Seventh Schedule, retention ceiling and processing-log floor
rules.check: artifact.data_retention_period_days <= tenant.dpdp_retention_policy_days AND artifact.processing_log_retention_days >= 365 AND no free-text evidence field contains an individual identifier marker (customer_id, user_id, email, phone, device_id, aadhaar)

rules.citation: DPDP Rules 2025, breach notification to the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals
rules.check: notification.to_dpbi_sent == true AND notification.to_affected_data_principals_sent == true AND notification.elapsed_hours <= 72

rules.citation: Meta and Google prohibited targeting-attribute policies, read with CHITRA rules-engine integrity policy ADR-003 and constitutional non-discrimination principles
rules.check: artifact.targeting_bases excludes religion_alone, caste, political_affiliation, sexual_orientation, health_condition and trade_union_membership, with no brand-declared exception
rules.failure_message: Targeting on a protected attribute. Reach the audience through content and context instead.

rules.citation: DPDP Act 2023, right to erasure, read with DPDP Rules 2025
rules.check: request.data_principal_authorization present AND request.reversal_window_bypassed == true AND request.completed_within_hours <= 72 AND request.cascade_to_external_platforms_confirmed == true

rules.citation: DPDP Act 2023 section 16, restriction on transfer outside India, read with MeitY country notifications
rules.check: artifact.destination_country not in meity.restricted_country_list AND artifact.transfer_basis_documented == true
rules.failure_message: Cross-border transfer flagged. Review against the current MeitY country list before Phase 3 enforcement on 13 May 2027.

rules.citation: DPDP Rules 2025, grievance redressal timelines
rules.check: grievance.resolved_within_days <= 90 AND grievance.acknowledgement_sent == true

rules.citation: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954, Schedule and section 3
rules.check: no Schedule condition or section 3 prohibition appears in the declared claim list or in the artifact copy
rules.failure_message: Claim addresses a condition in the DMRA Schedule.

rules.citation: RBI guidelines on advertising of banking, lending and credit products
rules.check: artifact copy contains a rate figure alongside APR or interest wording AND a terms-apply line AND no guaranteed-returns phrase

rules.citation: SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds, advertisement code
rules.check: artifact copy contains the statutory market-risk sentence AND if video, disclaimer visible at least 5s with voiceover

rules.citation: IRDAI (Insurance Advertisements and Disclosure) Regulations
rules.check: artifact copy contains an IRDAI registration number AND a policy terms disclosure AND no misleading returns phrase

rules.citation: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 (Act 32 of 2025), sections prohibiting advertisement of online money games, in force 1 October 2025
rules.check: false
rules.failure_message: Advertising online money games is prohibited under Act 32 of 2025. Direct and indirect promotion both attract imprisonment up to 2 years and a fine up to Rs 50 lakh. E-sports recognised under the National Sports Governance Act 2025 and online social games without stakes are outside this prohibition and must be declared under esports_recognised or online_social_gaming_no_stakes.

rules.citation: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
rules.check: false
rules.failure_message: Direct tobacco advertising is banned in India and surrogate advertising is heavily scrutinised.

rules.citation: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements 2022 read with the ASCI Guidelines for Qualification of Brand Extension, as updated 14 December 2023
rules.check: no direct promotion, AND a ca_attestation_id resolving as a valid brand-extension certificate in the credential registry, AND no alcohol consumption imagery
rules.failure_message: Alcohol-adjacent advertising is blocked by default. Only a genuine brand extension certified by an independent CA firm against the ASCI thresholds may proceed.

rules.citation: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, section 11 advertisement disclosure
rules.check: artifact.contains_rera_registration_number == true AND artifact.contains_project_details_disclosure == true

rules.citation: ASCI Guidelines for Advertising of Educational Institutions and Programs
rules.check: artifact.guarantees_specific_exam_rank_or_marks == false AND artifact.uses_fear_of_failure_appeals_to_parents == false AND artifact.uses_unverified_testimonials_of_minors == false

rules.citation: Consumer Protection Act 2019 misleading advertisement provisions read with MoHFW advertising restrictions
rules.check: artifact.health_claims_have_evidence_id == true AND artifact.uses_doctor_endorsement_for_drug_without_DGCI_approval == false

rules.citation: Trade Marks Act, 1999, sections 29 and 30 on infringement and comparative use
rules.check: legal_precheck.trademark_clearance_passed == true AND (artifact.references_competitor_mark == false OR artifact.comparative_claim_substantiated == true)

rules.citation: Copyright Act, 1957, licence documentation for music, stock imagery and likeness
rules.check: every declared use has a corresponding documented licence or contract

rules.citation: IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2026, amended 10 February 2026, synthetic media provisions
rules.applies_when: artifact.uses_voice_clone == true OR artifact.uses_face_swap == true OR artifact.uses_likeness_synthesis == true
rules.check: artifact.subject_consent_documented == true AND artifact.deepfake_label_present == true AND artifact.content_credentials_attached == true AND artifact.depicts_fabricated_endorsement == false AND artifact.depicts_fake_authority_figure == false
rules.failure_message: Fabricated endorsements, unauthorised likenesses and fake authority figures are prohibited outright. Consent and labelling do not cure them.

rules.citation: WhatsApp Business Platform Policy, marketing template and opt-in requirements
rules.check: consent_vault.lookup(artifact.opt_in_consent_artifact_id).status == 'valid' AND channel == 'whatsapp' AND artifact.template_pre_approved == true AND artifact.respects_24h_utility_window == true

rules.citation: Meta special ad categories policy
rules.check: artifact.special_ad_category_declared_in_meta == true

rules.citation: Meta Graph and Marketing API v26.0 changelog, 29 July 2026, placement removals
rules.check: artifact.placements disjoint from ['instagram_explore_feed','messenger_stories']
rules.failure_message: Instagram Explore Feed returns an API error and Messenger Stories is silently stripped from v26.0. Silent stripping means the campaign runs with targeting the media plan does not describe.

rules.citation: CHITRA cultural risk register, religious representation markers, curated per v1.2.2 section 9.1
rules.check: cultural_risk_audit.completed == true AND artifact.does_not_mock_religion == true

rules.citation: CHITRA cultural risk register read with constitutional non-discrimination principles
rules.check: artifact.uses_caste_stereotypes == false AND artifact.implies_caste_hierarchy == false

rules.citation: CHITRA cultural risk register, gender representation markers
rules.check: artifact.reinforces_harmful_gender_stereotypes == false AND artifact.uses_misogyny_for_humor == false AND artifact.uses_body_shaming == false

rules.citation: CHITRA cultural risk register, regional and linguistic representation markers
rules.check: artifact.mocks_regional_accent_for_humor == false AND artifact.implies_regional_hierarchy == false

rules.citation: CHITRA cultural risk register, political neutrality markers
rules.check: artifact.takes_partisan_political_position_unless_brand_is_political == false AND artifact.references_living_political_figure_unflatteringly == false

rules.citation: CHITRA v1.2.3 section 6, cross-tenant exclusion enforcement
rules.check: artifact.referenced_tenant_ids subset of [context.tenant_id] AND artifact.competitor_archive_references respect tenant.competitive_exclusions

rules.citation: Copyright Act, 1957, territorial scope of music licensing
rules.check: no placement in the plan reaches beyond the licensed territory
rules.failure_message: Music licensed for a single territory but placed on globally reaching surfaces. Verify territory clearance.

rules.citation: CHITRA v1.2 section K, human-in-the-loop gates, budget authority
rules.applies_when: any action in artifact.actions_taken carries a budget_shift_percent
rules.check: every budget shift above tenant.hitl_budget_shift_threshold_pct carries hitl_triggered and a human_approver_id
rules.failure_message: Budget shift recorded without HITL approval. Revert or mark pending until approved.

rules.citation: Personality and publicity rights as recognised by Indian courts, read with CHITRA legal-liability gating policy ADR-018
rules.applies_when: artifact declares any identifiable real person
rules.check: every identifiable real person carries a release_document_uri, unless a public figure depicted in editorial context
rules.failure_message: Identifiable real person depicted without a signed release.

rules.citation: CHITRA research substantiation policy ADR-020, 16 August 2026
rules.check: every region in campaign.geography appears in campaign.research_coverage, or carries a waiver in campaign.research_coverage_waivers naming an approver
rules.failure_message: Campaign geography includes a region the audience research does not cover. Territories for that market would rest on insight never tested there. Remove the region, extend the research, or record a waiver naming the approver.
